about: Hermes tools a taught phrase may call as steps, by their registry names (an MCP tool is mcp__<server>__<tool>). A tool belongs here only if it changes nothing, does not read across chats or people (no search of other conversations), and is safe when its arguments come from a person's words or from an earlier step's result, which may be a web page's text (so no tool that lets such text choose a URL, a path or a file to read, and no spend without a cap), with a result that is fenced as untrusted when it carries outside text. `think` is added in code. A tool runs as a step only while Hermes offers it on that platform: one in a disabled toolset, one whose availability check fails, or one that is not registered is left out. A step gives the tool's required text parameters, or the ones `params` names.
